        +getPets() List~Pet~
        +addPet(Pet pet) void

        +getPet(Integer id) Pet
        +getPet(String name, boolean ignoreNew) Pet
        +addVisit(Integer petId, Visit visit) void

    }

    class Pet

    }

    class OwnerController {
        -OwnerRepository owners

        +processCreationForm(Owner owner, BindingResult result, RedirectAttributes ra) String
        +processFindForm(int page, Owner owner, BindingResult result, Model model) String
        +processUpdateOwnerForm(Owner owner, BindingResult result, int ownerId, RedirectAttributes ra) String
        +showOwner(int ownerId) ModelAndView
    }

    class PetController {
        -OwnerRepository owners
        +findOwner(int ownerId) Owner
        +findPet(int ownerId, Integer petId) Pet
        +initCreationForm(Owner owner, ModelMap model) String
        +processCreationForm(Owner owner, Pet pet, BindingResult result, RedirectAttributes ra) String
        +processUpdateForm(Owner owner, Pet pet, BindingResult result, RedirectAttributes ra) String
        -updatePetDetails(Owner owner, Pet pet) void
    }

    class VisitController {
        -OwnerRepository owners
        +loadPetWithVisit(int ownerId, int petId, Map model) Visit
        +processNewVisitForm(Owner owner, int petId, Visit visit, BindingResult result, RedirectAttributes ra) String
    }
